name.fr-FR: La Vie et le Royaume de Jésus dans les âmes chrétiennes
name.en-US: The Life and Kingdom of Jesus in Christian Souls
name.pt-BR: A Vida e o Reino de Jesus nas almas cristãs

description.fr-FR: Le grand livre de Jean Eudes (1637) : sept parties d’exercices pour faire vivre et régner Jésus dans l’âme, de la journée, de l’année, des vertus, des mystères, des sacrements et de la mort.
description.en-US: John Eudes’s great book (1637): seven parts of exercises to make Jesus live and reign in the soul, covering the day, the year, the virtues, the mysteries, the sacraments and death.
description.pt-BR: O grande livro de João Eudes (1637): sete partes de exercícios para fazer Jesus viver e reinar na alma, sobre o dia, o ano, as virtudes, os mistérios, os sacramentos e a morte.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 1, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
